text:
ConocoPhillips rose 2.67% today to $154.03, driven by a sharp jump in crude oil prices—US oil climbed to $103.37 per barrel while world oil hit $123.10, reflecting geopolitical risk premiums as tensions between the US and Iran remain elevated despite mediation efforts. The company has gained 5.13% over two weeks as oil prices have strengthened, directly boosting the earnings power of a major crude producer.

The broader backdrop amplifies this move: refining margins have surged as fuel supplies tightened (a tailwind for energy companies), and despite Trump's campaign promise to lower gas prices, gasoline and diesel have climbed instead—supporting crude values and reducing pressure on oil producers' top-line revenue.
